summary: Revise at 5.0 (Caiman 7, ship 7.5). The across-openwork head now passes the subject read: at 300 px it is a Gothic chapel or shrine front with a skull in a pointed niche, two pinnacles, a gable with a sapphire, and three cabochons in pointed niches on the plinth. As a piece of jewellery it is far below the bar. Every surface is a flat extruded plane with a 45-degree chamfer. The pinnacles are smooth cones capped with ball bearings, with no crockets. The gable carries a single flat fleur outline and a ring groove. The skull is a line glyph, two circles, a triangle and a slot, cut 0.1-0.2 mm into a flat disc, so in face-300 it reads as an emoji. The roof slopes, the chest's long walls and the lid cresting are invisible from every camera. The shoulders and palm are a bare polished band: the specified graded quatrefoils are missing, so the theme stops at the head. From reverse and palm the back of the head is a blank slab with two stray notches. The stone census flags all six cabochons as 'no setting holds this stone' and lists two crowding pairs at 1.09 mm, and neither is explained. cut_lands is recorded as an empty list. Those two items are unverified gates, which makes this an automatic revise even apart from the score. Geometry, bore, thickness at 0.8 mm, DFM, stone count, cold reload, export size and both casting patterns are green and match the JSON. Round 2 has to make the architecture sculpted and dense (mouldings, crockets, tracery, a carved skull) and carry the theme down the shank.
strengths: The subject reads at 300 px without a caption: Gothic shrine or reliquary with a memento-mori skull (it passed read-test 6, and the final renders match it).
The plinth's three cabochons in pointed lancet niches (side.png) are the best passage on the ring: legible, coloured (garnet, sapphire, garnet) and architectural.
The pointed archivolt round the skull, with its pierced dark lights on either side of the skull, gives the face its one real depth cue.
The silhouette (an upright gabled front between two needle pinnacles) is distinct from the wheel, keel, rose, seal, buttress and octagon rings.

Clean engineering: watertight, 0 degenerates and 0 crossings on the ring, on 22 made parts and on both casting patterns; nothing in the bore; thickness clean at 0.8 mm on metal (0.907 sampled min) and lid (0.831); 0 DFM findings; the lid is a Separate casting with a recorded three-knuckle hinge Joint; no Stored meshes.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: The theme lives only on the head. Shoulders, sides and palm are a plain polished band (side.png, shoulder.png, palm.png). The spec's 3 graded quatrefoil piercings per shoulder at theta 90±(48,60,72) are absent. The back of the head (palm.png, reverse.png) is a blank slab with two stray notches.

checklist.item: Reads as its Gothic subject at 300 px without caption
checklist.reason: In hero-300 and face-300 the head reads as a Gothic shrine front with a pointed niche, a skull, a gable and pinnacles. It reads as a chapel more than a lidded chasse, but it names a reliquary or shrine and 'Gothic'.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp
checklist.reason: Outlines are crisp, but the skull is a schematic glyph rather than a figure: two ring-shaped sockets, a triangular nose and a rectangular mouth slot, each sunk a fraction of a millimetre into a flat disc, with sinuous lines at the temples (stones.png). The gable fleur is a flat silhouette with no modelling. Crisp, but not sculpted relief.

checklist.item: Stones in made settings, visible, coloured
checklist.reason: The stones are visible and correctly coloured (garnet 0.30/0.02/0.03, sapphire 0.02/0.06/0.45), and collets are modelled. But the stone census warns 'no setting holds this stone' for all 6, so the collets are not registered as settings. The crowding census lists 2 pairs at 1.09/1.08 mm with no explanation. The gable sapphire sits in a bare oval rim on a flat field.

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms sculpted
checklist.reason: The main failure. The head is stacked rectangular slabs with uniform 45-degree chamfers: bed, plinth, chest, towers. The pinnacles are plain cones with spheres on top, and the faces are flat planes. House rule 10 says 'a render that reads as stacked boxes fails the review round', and hero.png and reverse.png read exactly so.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: a procedural Flat 4.6 × 2.3 band. The band keeps clean flat walls.

checklist.item: Distinct silhouette; custom head >= 13 mm; shoulder ornament not cut off
checklist.reason: The silhouette is distinct in the collection. The head spans about 14.3 mm (sketch extents x -7.7..6.6) by 11.8 mm across (y ±5.9) and stands 6.6 mm over the crest. There is no shoulder ornament to cut off, which is itself the checklist-1 failure.

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: Large forms are present and medium forms are thin: niche, gable, pinnacles. Small forms are almost absent: no crockets, cusping, mouldings with profile, tracery, diaper or texture. Caiman's hero carries three scales of form across the whole top and shoulders. Capsa's head has broad blank planes, and its band is bare.

gates.verified: 22 parts listed in draft.parts, all watertight/0/0

No verification.json. Design is 423,520 bytes, over the 300 KB procedural budget the doc sets, and format_version is 6 where the doc says it stays format 5. Flagged for when the gate runs.

punch_list.zone: Pinnacles (Loft the north/south spire, Knop on the north/south spire) and the tower blocks
punch_list.change: Replace the smooth cones and ball knops with crocketed pinnacles. Give each spire 4 faces with 3-4 crockets per arris (hooked lobes 0.5-0.6 mm proud), and top it with a cross-shaped or fleur finial about 1.2 mm tall in place of the sphere. Break each tower block with two set-offs (weathered ledges, 0.3 mm step) and a gabletted top where the spire springs.
punch_list.acceptance: In hero.png each pinnacle shows at least 3 crockets per visible edge, and no sphere remains. In hero-300 the pinnacle silhouettes are serrated, not smooth needles.

punch_list.zone: Skull (Loft the skull…, Sink the eye sockets, the nasal cavity and the line of the teeth)
punch_list.change: Model the skull as relief, not a glyph. Domed cranium standing at least 0.8 mm proud of the niche back. Eye sockets as deep rounded orbits (0.5 mm, diameter about 1.0 mm), not rings. A notched nasal aperture. Cheekbones, and a jaw with 6-8 individual teeth, replacing the single slot. Remove the sinuous temple lines.
punch_list.acceptance: In stones.png the skull shows shaded volume (lit cranium, dark orbits) with countable teeth. In face-300 it reads as a carved skull, not an emoji face.

punch_list.change: Carry the theme down the shank. Add the specified 3 graded quatrefoil piercings each side at theta 90±(48,60,72), sized 2.0/1.7/1.4 mm, each within a raised 0.3 mm cusped frame. Or run a blind lancet arcade (bays 1.8 mm wide, 0.3 mm deep) on each shank wall, fading out by theta 90±85. Keep the palm plain.
punch_list.acceptance: In shoulder.png and side.png at least 3 four-lobed openings or lancets are visible per side. In hero-300 the shank no longer reads as a plain band.

punch_list.zone: Chest front, gable, plinth and bed (all chamfer-only mouldings)
punch_list.change: Replace the uniform 45-degree chamfers with profiled mouldings: a roll-and-hollow string course (0.4 mm proud) at the gable foot and at the plinth top, and a weathered base course. Add cusping (trefoil, 3 cusps) inside the archivolt. Crocket the gable rakes with 4-5 leaf crockets per side, 0.5 mm proud. Model the fleur finial as a three-petal fleur with relief, not a flat outline. Add a pierced or blind trefoil to each gable shoulder to frame the sapphire.
punch_list.acceptance: Neither hero.png nor face.png shows a single plain sloped facet longer than 3 mm on the front. The gable rakes are serrated in silhouette at 300 px.

punch_list.zone: Back and sides of the head: chest long walls, roof slopes, rear slab (reverse.png, palm.png, shoulder.png)
punch_list.change: Make the head read as a chasse in the round. Cut a three-bay blind lancet arcade (0.3 mm deep, posts 0.8 mm) on the visible rear and side walls. Make the roof slopes and their roundel tracery visible from the hero camera, or raise the ridge so the slopes show. Remove the two stray notches on the rear slab, or turn them into designed lights.
punch_list.acceptance: In reverse.png the rear face shows pointed bays, and no unexplained notch remains. In shoulder.png a roof slope with tracery is visible.

punch_list.change: Make the collets register as settings. Use head.bezel {wall_mm 0.35, lip 0.3} (or the equivalent setting feature the census recognises) for each of the 6 cabochons, so the census reports a setting per stone. Resolve or explain in the report the two 1.09 mm wall-to-plinth-niche crowding pairs. Give the gable sapphire a bezel framed by a cusped quatrefoil or rose, not a plain ring groove.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json stones.warnings is empty, and crowding is empty or carries a written explanation. In stones.png every stone shows a raised bezel lip.

punch_list.change: Record the asserted lands: populate cut_lands with each through-cut and niche (west window, back lights 1-2, slope roundels, plinth niches, wall bays) and its measured land at 0.8 mm. When the template gate runs, address the 423 KB design against the 300 KB budget and the format 6 versus 5 note.
punch_list.acceptance: cut_lands lists at least one entry per cut feature, each at or above 0.8 mm.
